title: MCPiler Manifest search section
description: Optional lexical index. Omit it and Engine rebuilds it from agentSurface and operations. It is a term store, not a permission list: whether an operation is discoverable is decided by the surface exposure list, never by presence here.

builderVersion.description: An index built by another builder version is ignored and rebuilt rather than trusted.

indexedFields.$comment: Not constrained to the catalogue. An unrecognised field carries weight 0, so it is inert rather than dangerous, and refusing it here would make this document stricter than the reader.
indexedFields.description: Catalogue: name, summary, description, tags, groups, httpPath, parameterName, parameterDescription, requestSchema, responseSchema, alias, keyword, exampleIntent, stepName, stepSummary.

fieldWeights.description: Part of the format so a Studio built and an Engine built index rank identically.

terms.description: Field name to terms. Same catalogue as indexedFields, and equally not constrained here.
